name: Wendigo
lore: It is believed that a traveler can turn into a Wendigo when forced to consume human flesh, either for survival or during some twisted ritual

name: Karakondjul
description: A dark, goblin-like nocturnal demon with a shaggy coat, buring red eyes, and sharp goat-like horns.
lore: Active during the dark winter days from Christmas to Epiphany, this monster tricks late-night travelers onto its back and rides them to exhaustion before throwing them off cliffs.

name: Leshy
description: A tall woodland guardian made of bark and roots, with green hair and eyes that glow like burning forest embers.
lore: As the master of the deep forest, the Leshy can shrink to the size of a blade of grass or swell to the height of the tallest oak. It leads hunters astray by imitating human voices.

name: Strigoi
description: A reanimated corpse with gaunt features, elongated claws, and blood-soaked teeth rising from desecrated graves.
lore: The troubled soul of a deceased person returning from the dead to absorb the vitality of their living relatives. It is considered a direct precursor to modern vampire legends.

name: Samodiva
description: An ethereal nymph of extreme beauty, wearing floating white gowns and glowing with mesmerizing woodland magic.
lore: Slavic forest spirits that dance in moonlit clearings. Any mortal who witnesses their dance is lured into a trance and forced to dance until dying of total exhaustion.
